Everything is complete. Here's the final report:

## Summary

**PR #475** — https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/475 — **OPEN, mergeable, all 7 required CI checks green** (`Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build`, `audit-check`, `Guardrail Presence Check`, `Asset Registry Coverage Check`, `Unit Tests`). `AUDIT: PASS` posted with the full 8-field structured verdict. **Not self-merged** — this is TIER2 (touches `drizzle/*.sql` + `schema.ts`), held for your sign-off per repo convention.

### What's now registry-backed vs. what stays hardcoded

- **`isKnownModel()`/`knownModels()`** (roster overrides) now query `platform.ai_model_registry` live — a new model becomes usable for a role override via a DB insert, no deploy.
- **The 4 named links in the platform's failover chain** — floor-tier default, its generic OpenRouter fallback, its Cerebras same-model failover, and the escalated-tier default — are now looked up from `ai_model_registry`'s new `role` column (with a short in-process cache), falling back to the old hardcoded literal (with a logged warning) only if the registry has no active row or the lookup errors. The *failover decision logic itself* (when to fail over, in what order) stays in code — only *which model fills each slot* moved to data.
- **Deliberately still hardcoded, unchanged:** `model-tier-eligibility.ts`'s `JUDGMENT_ELIGIBLE`/`INTEGRATIVE_ELIGIBLE` sets. "Is this model real" and "is this model trusted for judgment-critical work" are different questions — the latter stays a code-reviewed guardrail per AGENTS.md Rule 9.

### Also in this PR
- Registered `openai/gpt-oss-20b` (Groq) as a real model — pricing verified live via groq.com/pricing. Registered only, not wired as a default.
- Added `customer_success` as a 4th `ai_router_scope` with `computeCustomerSuccessResolution()`, mirroring the existing `sales_marketing` scope. No call site wired yet, matching the other unwired scopes' documented posture.
- Fixed one real CodeQL finding (`js/tainted-format-string`, high severity) introduced by my own new error-logging line.

**One disclosed, out-of-scope item:** CodeQL alert #24 — the same rule, at a different line in `roster-overrides.ts` (`resolveEffectiveModel`'s error log) — predates this PR (already open on `main` since 2026-07-18). Not fixed here since it's unrelated to this task's scope; flagging it for a separate follow-up.

Claim stays in `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml`'s `active:` section (not moved to `recently_completed`) until you merge, per that file's own protocol.
